description: SSE-based real-time event delivery with glob filtering

requirements.title: SSE streaming
requirements.description: Server-Sent Events endpoint with 30s heartbeat, retry: 5000ms, standard SSE format

requirements.title: SSE message format compliance
requirements.description: SSE frames use standard format: id/event/data fields for events, comment lines for heartbeats

requirements.title: Heartbeat comment format
requirements.description: Heartbeats written as SSE comments (: heartbeat) with optional data payload

requirements.title: SSE headers and retry directive
requirements.description: SSE endpoint sets Content-Type, Cache-Control, Connection, X-Accel-Buffering headers and retry directive

requirements.title: Glob-pattern filtering
requirements.description: Segment-aware glob matching: * matches one segment, ** matches one or more

requirements.title: Last-Event-ID resume
requirements.description: SSE clients can reconnect with Last-Event-ID to replay missed events from store

requirements.title: Backpressure handling
requirements.description: 64-capacity subscriber channels with non-blocking send; dropped events counted in heartbeat

requirements.title: Channel buffering capacity
requirements.description: Subscriber channels use 64-capacity buffer with non-blocking send

requirements.title: Drop counting accuracy
requirements.description: Dropped events accurately counted and reported in heartbeat data

requirements.title: Heartbeat drop reporting
requirements.description: Heartbeat messages include dropped event count for backpressure monitoring

requirements.title: Heartbeat interval configuration
requirements.description: Heartbeat interval configurable with default 30s ticker

requirements.title: Proxy buffering prevention
requirements.description: X-Accel-Buffering: no header prevents nginx/reverse proxy buffering

requirements.title: Pattern compilation and caching
requirements.description: Glob patterns compiled once at subscription creation and cached for reuse

requirements.title: Wildcard segment matching
requirements.description: Single * matches one path segment, ** matches one or more segments

requirements.title: Multi-field filter composition
requirements.description: Filters applied on type, source, and target fields independently

requirements.title: Last-Event-ID header parsing
requirements.description: Extracts and validates numeric Last-Event-ID from SSE reconnection header

requirements.title: Invalid ID graceful handling
requirements.description: Non-numeric or missing Last-Event-ID treated as fresh connection

requirements.title: Replay window bounded query
requirements.description: Replays limited to store retention window with configurable max replay count

requirements.title: Atomic drop counter increment
requirements.description: Drop counter uses atomic increment for concurrent safety

requirements.title: Cumulative drop count in heartbeat payload
requirements.description: Heartbeat data field includes total dropped events since connection
